decisions.reason: Although it is related to skincare, the coffee-based men’s line is a more peripheral themed extension for a firm with a narrow range and no visible later evidence of market traction, so absorptive-capacity logic favors reallocating resources to closer-to-core products and development.

The facial cleansing foam fits very closely with the firm’s established natural facial-care know-how and an existing series, making it easier to refine and commercialize through accumulated knowledge and therefore worth retaining.
